The 2025 Openfront Masters World Cup is the first ever official OpenFront tournament hosted by OpenFront Masters

About

Format

  • Finals - May 10th, 2025
    • 30 qualified teams of duos have qualified through a qualification phase occuring the weekend prior
    • Up to 11 duo matches played using a match-point system
    • Teams earn points based on their performance in game
  • Point Distribution (per match)
      • 1st: 50 points
      • 2nd: 30 points
      • 3rd: 15 points
      • 4th: 0 points
  • Scoring Method
    • At the end of each match, the team holding the crown at the end of the game wins.
    • Points are also awarded to 2nd and 3rd place of each match, judgment made by the referees according to team performance.
    • When a team reaches 100 points, they reach a finalist position, in which they have to win one game to take the trophy.
